Project overview

Aileen Villas Rawai is a very small project by Trinity Property, the developer of the Aileen Villas communities in Layan and Sakhu and of Aileen Rawai Townhouses. It consists of two four-bedroom, four-bathroom villas on a site of about 1,600 sqm, built to order with a construction period of about 10 months.

The site is in central Rawai, a few minutes' walk from Wat Sawang Arom, a Lotus supermarket and local cafes, and about 400 m from Rawai Beach. Each villa has two parking spaces, and the plot is covered by 24-hour security and CCTV.

Payments follow construction: a THB 200,000 reservation, 30% on contract, then stages for the foundation, structure, walls, finishing and 5% on handover. No asking price is published and the developer has listed the project as sold out, so please ask us whether a plot is still available.
